tickets.text: Use this coordination workflow to address the missing signature page in the 529 bank authorization package for Selena Thimblefern. Confirm the needed correction before contacting the client and keep the request limited to the deficient item.

subTasks.title: Confirm planning or account impact

subTasks.title: Send corrected signature request
subTasks.text: Contact the client through the approved secure channel with clear instructions, the corrected form or signature page, and a brief explanation of what is needed. Avoid sending unnecessary pages containing sensitive information.
